articles.title: America Is Burning Through Its Emergency Oil Reserves at Record Speed. Half the Crude Is Being Shipped Overseas.
articles.excerpt: The US Strategic Petroleum Reserve has dropped to 365 million barrels after back-to-back record weekly drawdowns. By the time the current release programme ends, reserves will hit their lowest level since the 1980s. Here is what NRI investors should understand.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Dell's AI Server Revenue Just Jumped 757 Per Cent. The Stock Gained 33 Per Cent in a Single Day. Here Is What NRI Tech Investors Should Know.
articles.excerpt: Dell reported $16.1 billion in AI server sales in a single quarter — more than its entire PC business. The company raised its full-year AI revenue outlook to $60 billion. For NRI investors holding US tech stocks, the AI infrastructure trade just entered a new phase.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Enterprise AI Spending Is Showing Its First Cracks. If You Hold US Tech Stocks, Your Portfolio May Be More Exposed Than You Think.
articles.excerpt: GPU rental prices have fallen 40 per cent, Fortune 20 companies are tightening AI budgets, and NRI investors with heavy US tech exposure need to think about what comes next.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: The RBI Decides on Rates This Week. So Does the US Jobs Report. NRI Investors Are Caught Between Two Central Banks With Very Different Problems.
articles.excerpt: India's Monetary Policy Committee meets June 3-5 with analysts split between a hold and a hike, while US nonfarm payrolls on Friday could cement the case for the Fed's first rate increase. Here is what NRI investors should watch across both economies.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Kevin Warsh Just Finished His First Week as Fed Chair. Markets Are Already Betting He Will Be Forced to Raise Rates.
articles.excerpt: Warsh was sworn in promising lower rates. But inflation at 3.8 per cent, oil prices 30 per cent above pre-war levels, and a nine-week stock rally have left him with almost no room to deliver. NRI investors face a June of dual central bank risk.
articles.nri_angle: NRI investors with both dollar and rupee holdings face a uniquely dangerous June. The RBI decides on June 5 and the Fed on June 16-17. A hawkish Fed with a steady RBI would widen the rate differential, pressure the rupee, and accelerate capital outflows from Indian equities. India's MSCI EM weight has already halved to 11 per cent.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: The US and Iran Have a Deal to Reopen the Strait of Hormuz. Markets Rallied. But a Reuters Analysis Says It May Change Nothing.
articles.excerpt: A 60-day truce extension would lift shipping restrictions and require Iran to de-mine the strait within 30 days. But global oil reserves are running out, the PCE just hit 3.8 per cent, and Friday's US jobs report could push the Fed toward a rate hike. Here is what NRI investors should watch.
articles.nri_angle: India imports 85 per cent of its crude oil. Every $10 rise in Brent costs India roughly $15 billion annually. The Hormuz deal directly affects the rupee, RBI rate decisions, NRI deposit rates, and inflation-sensitive portfolios held by diaspora investors.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Oil Analysts Have Raised Their 2026 Forecasts for the Third Time. The Era of $60 Brent May Be Over.
articles.excerpt: Brent is now forecast to average $90.44 a barrel this year, up 40 per cent from February estimates. Middle East crude exports have halved. Even a ceasefire will not undo the structural damage quickly. Here is what NRI investors should understand.
articles.nri_angle: For NRIs with India exposure through mutual funds, NRE/NRO deposits, or direct equity holdings, elevated oil prices are the single biggest macro variable. A weaker rupee erodes dollar-denominated returns on Indian assets, remittances buy less due to fuel-driven domestic inflation, and rate-sensitive sectors face headwinds if the RBI is forced to hike.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: US Inflation Just Hit 3.8 Per Cent. Markets Are Now Pricing a Fed Rate Hike Over a Cut. Here Is What That Means for NRI Investors.
articles.excerpt: The April PCE reading is the highest since May 2023. The S&P 500 has risen for nine straight weeks anyway. On June 5, both the US jobs report and the RBI rate decision land on the same day. Your portfolio in both countries is on the line.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: India Just Raised Gold Import Duty to 15 Per Cent. Demand Has Collapsed, Discounts Hit $106 an Ounce, and Jewellers Are Refusing to Stock Up.
articles.excerpt: The duty hike from 6 to 15 per cent — the steepest in a decade — has frozen India's gold market. Retail footfall has cratered, dealers are quoting record discounts, and NRIs planning weddings or gifts face a significant cost increase.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: The US Just Dropped Fraud Charges Against Gautam Adani. His Stock Surged 22 Per Cent in May. Here Is What NRI Investors Should Understand About What Happened.
articles.excerpt: The DOJ criminal case is closed, the SEC has settled, and the Treasury resolved an Iran sanctions case for $275 million. Bernstein says the worst is over. But the Adani saga reshaped how global capital views Indian conglomerates — and that lesson has not been unlearned.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: The Rupee Just Had Its Best Day in Two Months. Oil Dropped, the RBI Stepped In, and a US-Iran Truce Extension Is on the Table. Here Is What the Week Ahead Looks Like.
articles.excerpt: The Indian currency surged 0.7 per cent to 95 per dollar on Friday after central bank intervention and a drop in crude prices. With the RBI meeting on June 5 and US jobs data on June 6, the next seven days will set the tone for Indian markets through the monsoon.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Indian Markets Just Closed Their Worst May in Three Years. The Nifty Lost 1.9 Per Cent, Foreign Investors Pulled $24 Billion, and the Monsoon Forecast Just Got Worse.
articles.excerpt: A monthly scorecard for NRI investors: what went wrong, what went right, and what to watch in June as the RBI prepares to decide on rates amid a weakening monsoon and an unresolved oil crisis.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: India's Forex Reserves Just Fell to a One-Year Low of $681 Billion. The RBI Is Burning Through Dollars to Defend the Rupee. Here Is What NRI Investors Should Watch.
articles.excerpt: The Reserve Bank of India's war chest shrank by $7.5 billion in a single week. Ceasefire hopes briefly pushed the rupee past 95. But the rate hike question looming over June 5 will determine what comes next for your deposits, remittances, and home loans.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: India's Weight in the MSCI Emerging Markets Index Just Fell From 20 Per Cent to 11. If You Own an EM Index Fund, a Chunk of Your India Exposure Just Disappeared.
articles.excerpt: The largest single-year weight reduction in MSCI's history for India could trigger billions in mechanical selling. Here is what NRI investors holding passive EM funds need to understand.
articles.image_caption: India's weight in the MSCI Emerging Markets Index has been cut from 20 per cent to 11.2 per cent.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: MSCI Just Added Paytm and Fortis Healthcare to Its Global Index. The Rebalancing Takes Effect Tomorrow and Could Push $2 Billion Into Indian Stocks.
articles.excerpt: India's weight in the MSCI Global Standard index has risen to 19 per cent, its highest ever. For NRI investors watching $24 billion in foreign outflows this year, the passive money flowing back in tells a different story.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Wipro's ADR Surged 18 Per Cent Overnight on an AI Deal With ServiceNow. Indian Markets Just Reopened. Here Is What NRI Investors Need to Know.
articles.excerpt: The Nifty IT index jumped 2.3 per cent at open. Brent crude fell to $93 on Iran ceasefire hopes. And the biggest question facing Indian IT — whether AI destroys the outsourcing model or reinvents it — just got a data point.
articles.image_caption: Indian markets reopened after the Bakrid holiday to a wall of AI-driven optimism — Wipro led the IT index with a 4.35 per cent jump.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: SEBI Just Rewrote India's Mutual Fund Rulebook. Your Fund Manager Now Has to Invest 20 Per Cent of Their Salary in Their Own Schemes.
articles.excerpt: The new regulations, effective since April 1, cap expense ratios, slash brokerage fees by up to 85 per cent, enforce portfolio overlap limits, and require fund managers to put their own money where their advice is. For NRI investors holding Indian mutual funds, every line item just changed.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: The RBI Meets on June 5. Bond Traders Are Pricing In 100 Basis Points of Hikes. Your Home Loan, Your NRI Deposits, and Your Remittances Are All on the Table.
articles.excerpt: Oil is above $90. The rupee just hit an all-time low. Inflation is back above 5 per cent. The Reserve Bank of India faces its hardest decision in two years — and NRIs have more at stake than most.
articles.image_caption: The RBI faces its most consequential monetary policy decision in two years as oil, inflation, and the rupee converge.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: A US Trade Delegation Is Coming to Delhi on June 1. The Full Bilateral Trade Agreement Is on the Table. Here Is What NRI Investors Need to Watch.
articles.excerpt: The interim deal cut tariffs to 18 per cent. The next round of talks aims to lock in market access, customs facilitation, and digital trade rules. For NRIs with money on both sides of the Pacific, the details will decide whether your portfolio tilts east or west.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk
